content.title: 4 Promotional Villas and Network Works
summary: Four detached promotional villas in Rouiba, delivered with full TCE, VRD, external access, and contemporary residential finishes.
The Rouiba project features a compact villa development where privacy, access, and external works are as important as the buildings themselves.
description: Igloo delivered the villas as a complete site package, including reinforced concrete structures, internal and external finishes, MEP networks, and roads and pedestrian access.
The project employs clean contemporary volumes and external arrangements to create a small-scale residential setting, emphasising durability, independence, and comfort.
content.authority: A small villa development where quality is achieved through execution: access, networks, facades, and finishing details are aligned from site to handover.
